functions.cfy_is_admin:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cfy_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from public.cfy_admin_users a where a.user_id=auth.uid()) $function$
functions.cfy_menu_create_order_v3:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cfy_menu_create_order_v3(p_code text, p_order jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare v_result jsonb; begin
  v_result:=public.cfy_menu_create_order(p_code,p_order);
  if coalesce((v_result->>'duplicate')::boolean,false) then return v_result; end if;
  return public.cfy_menu_finalize_created_order_v3((v_result->>'id')::uuid,p_order,v_result);
end $function$
